4759695c087a65808f81ad23d3dacb1190be17d5.sourceText: 另一个已确认的源码缺口是初始化保护：点云回调没有检查初始 TF 是否成功，直接使用缓存。容器的 `tf2::Transform` 默认构造不初始化数值，而节点也没有先将缓存设为单位变换。如果点云先到、或首次 TF 查询一直失败，可能使用未初始化矩阵；触发后的运行表现本轮未测试。
4759695c087a65808f81ad23d3dacb1190be17d5.translatedText: Another confirmed source code gap is initialization protection: the point cloud callback does not check whether the initial TF succeeded and directly uses the cache\. The container's `tf2::Transform` default constructor does not initialize values, and the node also does not first set the cache to an identity transform\. If the point cloud arrives first, or the initial TF query keeps failing, an uninitialized matrix may be used; the runtime behavior after triggering was not tested in this round\.

47f2e378a66dd4a18b732a491e9e0db1839b5d2e.sourceText:
| 示例 | 讲了什么 | 新出现的语法 | 为什么这样写 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | nullptr 基本用法 | `nullptr`、`p == nullptr` | 初始化指针为"空"，类型安全 | nullptr 的类型是 `std::nullptr_t` |
| 示例 2 | 解决重载歧义 | 重载函数中 nullptr 匹配指针版本 | NULL 不能区分整数和指针重载，nullptr 可以 | 这就是 nullptr 替代 NULL 的核心原因 |
| 示例 3 | 模板和智能指针 | `shared_ptr = nullptr`、`if(sp)` | 智能指针也能用 nullptr 初始化 | 智能指针的 bool 转换等价于 `!= nullptr` |
| 示例 4 | 多个指针重载 | `int*`、`double*`、`nullptr` | nullptr 能排除整数重载，但不能替你选择具体指针类型 | 多个指针重载时先把 nullptr 放进明确类型的指针变量 |
47f2e378a66dd4a18b732a491e9e0db1839b5d2e.translatedText:
| Example | What it explains | Newly introduced syntax | Why it is written this way | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | Basic usage of nullptr | `nullptr`、`p == nullptr` | Initialize a pointer to "null", type\-safe | The type of nullptr is `std::nullptr_t` |
| Example 2 | Resolving overload ambiguity | In overloaded functions, nullptr matches the pointer version | NULL cannot distinguish between integer and pointer overloads, but nullptr can | This is the core reason nullptr replaces NULL |
| Example 3 | Templates and smart pointers | `shared_ptr = nullptr`、`if(sp)` | Smart pointers can also be initialized with nullptr | The bool conversion of a smart pointer is equivalent to `!= nullptr` |
| Example 4 | Multiple pointer overloads | `int*`、`double*`、`nullptr` | nullptr can exclude integer overloads, but it cannot choose a specific pointer type for you | When there are multiple pointer overloads, first put nullptr into a pointer variable with an explicit type |
